description: Adversarial: horizons 1, 3 and 12 months with a horizon column; the h-step errors are MA(h - 1) and must NOT be reported as residual autocorrelation.
comment: True h-step forecasts of an AR(1): the errors are MA(h - 1) by construction; a test that starts at lag 1 would reject for h = 3 and h = 12, the correct test starts at lag h and does not.
